mapper.select: SELECT 'EMP' AS user_type, emp_id AS user_id, phone_no AS phone_number FROM tb_emp WHERE hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND ward_id = #{wardId} AND role_cd = 'USER' AND auth_st = 'APPROVED' AND phone_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(phone_no) <> '' ORDER BY emp_id

SELECT 'EMP' AS user_type, e.emp_id AS user_id, e.phone_no AS phone_number FROM tb_emp_location el JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = el.location_id JOIN tb_emp e ON e.emp_id = el.emp_id WHERE e.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND l.ward_id = #{wardId} AND l.location_nm = #{locationName} AND e.role_cd = 'USER' AND e.auth_st = 'APPROVED' AND e.phone_no IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.phone_no) <> '' ORDER BY e.emp_id

SELECT 'CAREGIVER' AS user_type, CONCAT('cg:', c.caregiver_id) AS user_id, c.phone_no AS phone_number FROM tb_caregiver c JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = c.location_id WHERE c.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId} AND l.ward_id = #{wardId} AND l.location_nm = #{locationName} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND TRIM(c.phone_no) <> '' ORDER BY c.caregiver_id

SELECT CAST(event_id AS VARCHAR) FROM tb_detection_event WHERE event_type = 'FALL' AND decision_st = 'CONFIRMED' AND (event_detail ->> 'duplicate_of') IS NULL AND crt_dt >= NOW() - (#{minutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute') ORDER BY crt_dt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sms_send_history ( event_id, user_type, user_id, phone_no, message_content, send_status, send_dt ) VALUES ( CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID), #{userType}, #{userId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{messageContent}, #{sendStatus}, CASE WHEN #{sendStatus} = 'SUCCESS' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END )
